integrity.claim_scope: single explicit Taft action and its trace ideal

scientific_limitations: The claim determines the radical of the contraction to the central polynomial subalgebra, not the full contracted ideal.
It does not classify the full noncommutative quotient or extend the calculation to other Taft actions.
A poorly indexed prior computation of this exact contraction remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact central support of the trace quotient in the Taft Auslander example
